name: Gloaming
description: A dim red dwarf with three close rocky worlds tidally braced against its flares. The two inner rocks are furnace and cinder while the outer one keeps its ice under a thin sky. Life, if it ever starts here, will have to love the dark.

stars.name: Gloaming Dim
stars.description: A small red dwarf glowing like a coal, prone to flares that strip the inner sky. Between outbursts it is perfectly steady for centuries. Its planets orbit close enough to feel every mood swing.

planets.name: Embercrag
planets.description: A lava-streaked rock locked face-to-star, one hemisphere molten and the other frozen. The twilight band between hosts the only stations, riding the terminator's crawl. Heat mining pays for everything here.

planets.name: Cindervale
planets.description: A basalt cinder wrapped in thin haze, pocked by impacts never weathered away. Subsurface ice lenses sustain a lonely research dome. The crew studies how fast flares sterilize a marginal sky.

planets.name: Duskwater
planets.description: An ice-capped world far enough out to keep its water frozen solid. Cryovolcanoes resurface the plains on geological schedules. A single icy moon shares its orbit in a slow gravitational waltz.

moons.name: Waltz
moons.description: A bright ice moon in a wide gentle orbit, its plumes feeding a faint ring. Tidal heating keeps a deep ocean liquid under kilometers of shell. Probes listen at the vents for chemistry with ambition.
